groups.title: PTSD: MAPP1/MAPP2 design context
groups.question: What registered measures, timing and treatment context need inspection before reading MAPP1 and MAPP2 together?
groups.description: Two phase-3 PTSD records retained for a design-reading case. This context is separate from the MDD collections; linked publications, protocol and FDA documents are external reading, not registry results.
groups.limitations: A common measure does not establish comparable populations, successful blinding, efficacy, safety or approval. Eligibility, arm assignments, results and regulatory conclusions are outside the retained field projection.
